The Spring holiday has already started and Blissful Island is greeting guests for the Spring King’s wedding with Wickedora. Everyone is invited, but it seems that some of the new arrivals are against this ceremony. Join the celebration, but watch out for anything suspicious! 

- New holiday island
- Weapons for all levels with new bonus “Attack power” and weapons with doubled bonuses
- Solo dungeons
- Holiday chests with new costumes, relics and other treasures
- Mass dynamic battle with rewards for each stage
- Guild’s fight the King of Clubs for especially precious rewards
- 12 collectible achievements
- Holiday skills
- Triumphant return of Arena 3х3 with party ban and two new maps for Temple of Seals
